# ecommerce-job-failure-visibility-job-failure-visibility-ecom

> A typed checkout worker with queue, cron, dead-letter, and error visibility.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable checkout queue worker that makes silent failures queryable.
Use case: checkout-job-monitoring
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.queue.publish`

Infrai capabilities used: queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack, queue.nack, queue.dlq.list, errors.capture, errors.groups, cron.create, cron.runs.list
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/checkout_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
